evidence: Wilson, Flora Checklist of Northamptonshire (2014): Primula veris L., Cowslip
terms.comment: Linnaeus’s name, “the primula of spring”. prīmula is the feminine of the diminutive prīmulus, which Lewis & Short has from Plautus, and takes its long ī.

sources: Rob Wilson, A Flora Checklist of Northamptonshire & The Soke of Peterborough (2014), on the website of the Botanical Society of Britain and Ireland.
Lewis & Short: ver
